protocol.source: Train GPS only; all observed states, no Validation or Test GPS or labels
protocol.held: Train departure UTCweek modulo5==0; every count and backoff excludes this complete fold
protocol.features: Cell, incoming heading from past, known destination equality, run-entry UTC4h bin and weekend; run entry computed from departure plus past elapsed time
protocol.objective: Proper three-event stay/move/end likelihood; no observed query length as predictor
protocol.smoothing: Global Dirichlet1; cell/heading/destination50; clock20 fixed before held evaluation
protocol.clock: UTC; distinguish from Lisbon local clock; no claim of exact UNITE reproduction
protocol.age: Elapsed dwell age from past; at inference age and elapsed time would be model-generated
protocol.scope: Local likelihood instrument, not an achieved OD duration MAE; training cohort and labels are unchanged
